caption: The drawing depicts a stylized wooden cross rendered in shades of pink, with darker pink lines and swirls indicating the wood grain texture. The main vertical beam is long, rectangular, and has a slightly rounded bottom, with visible grain patterns running along its length. The crossbeam is shorter, made up of three distinct segments on each side, each segment featuring a rounded, carved end, also showing wood grain. At the top of the vertical beam, there are three horizontal, carved tiered shapes stacked atop each other, also colored in pink. Several small circular metallic elements, possibly nails or studs, are depicted on the intersection of the beams and near the bottom of the vertical beam, colored in a grayish tone. The background is a plain, off-white color. In the lower right corner, there is green text reading "MADEL G. CLAFLIN, TAOS."
title: Red Wooden Cross used as Headstone
